operatorDecision: Accept S01/S02 as personal_local first-materialization residuals; retarget Item 7 closeout at the managed/production sites. Chosen after A1 (build a genuine personal identity thread + provisioning) was scoped and found to require a persistent personal Catalog + onboarding provisioning + migration (a multi-module architectural project, not a batch).
conclusions: S01 (src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply.ts:164, resolveEmployeeBuiltinStewardWorkspaceDir) and S02 (get-reply.ts:165, resolveAgentWorkspaceDir) are the personal_local first-materialization fallbacks; they are formally ACCEPTED as personal_local residuals and are NOT counted toward the Item 7 production retirement target.

They are NOT reachable in managed_enterprise: resolveWorkspaceDirAfterAuthorization (src/gateway/workspace/handler-bridge.ts:872) returns null (fail-closed) for managed_enterprise when the trusted locator produced no authorizedCwd, and only invokes personalFallback (S01/S02) when the profile is personal_local. So S01/S02 carry no managed/multi-tenant isolation risk.

They are not honestly retirable in the production read path (two independent walls; see twoWallJustification). Forcing a retirement would either derive ownership from an agentId slug (forbidden) or synthesize a Catalog binding in production (forbidden by the Phase 0 freeze).

The Item 7 production retirement target is therefore the 8 managed/production live sites (memory index/sync), not the 2 personal_local residuals. Item 7 stays not-met until those 8 reach their honest end-state.

This change retires nothing, modifies no source, does not modify the retirement scan, keeps remaining/liveWriteWatchIndex=10 and frozenWriteWatchIndex=38, keeps item 7 not-met, and preserves every lock. The honest full-zero path (A1) remains available as a separate future project.

wall1_semanticGate.finding: personal_local carries no server-trusted principal at the call site; the only inputs are agentId (S02) / employeeOwnerId (S01) + cfg; LEGACY_LOCATOR_CALLER_MATRIX P1 forbids an agentId-only canonical query (agent_id_slug_query_forbidden); principle #3 forbids deriving ownership from an agentId slug. A resolver swap is circular.

wall2_freezeSynthesisProhibition.method: Implemented resolvePersonalWorkspacePrincipal (deviceId install owner) + provisionPersonalWorkspace (placement + Catalog-first binding + fencing) + wired into get-reply personalFallback, then ran the trusted Phase 0 freeze scanner.
wall2_freezeSynthesisProhibition.result: freeze ok=false: buildUserOwnedWorkspaceCatalogEntry is a watched SYNTHESIS_SYMBOL, so establishing (minting) a Catalog binding in the production get-reply read path is reported as addedCatalogSynthesis (also addedProductionCallSites P4). The Phase 0 freeze forbids added production Catalog synthesis: production must READ a pre-existing canonical binding, not mint one.
wall2_freezeSynthesisProhibition.consequence: personal_local has no pre-existing personal Catalog binding, and production cannot synthesize one. An honest retirement therefore requires a persistent personal Catalog + onboarding/first-run provisioning (mint once, outside the per-message read path) + migration/backfill, then get-reply reads the binding. That is a multi-module architectural project (A1), not a batch. The implementation attempt was reverted; the tree is unchanged.
wall2_freezeSynthesisProhibition.wouldNotEvade: Inlining the binding construction to avoid the watched SYNTHESIS_SYMBOL would evade freeze detection while still synthesizing in production; that violates the governance intent and was explicitly not done.

managedFailClosedEvidence.behavior: authorizedCwd (trusted locator) wins; else managed_enterprise -> null (fail-closed, no legacy fallback); else (personal_local) -> personalFallback(). S01/S02 live only inside personalFallback.

item7ClosureTargetReframe.note: Item 7 = met requires the 8 managed/production memory index/sync sites to reach their honest end-state (Stage C managed identity thread + Stage D persistent sync + shadow/canary). The 2 accepted personal_local residuals are excluded from the reach-zero target because production cannot synthesize their binding and managed never reaches them.

honestFullRetirementPath.label: A1 (deferred)
steps: Add a persistent personal workspace Catalog (not in-memory, not per-message synthesized).
Provision the personal workspace binding ONCE at onboarding/first-run (outside the per-message production read path).
get-reply READS the pre-existing binding (freeze-safe read, no synthesis).
Migration/backfill for existing installs so the read never fails closed on upgrade.
honestFullRetirementPath.scope: multi-module architectural project; high blast radius (default personal_local workspace path); separate from this acceptance.

rollback.note: Evidence/handoff/attribution only; no code, no scan mutation. Rollback = revert the CR commits; the scan and all 10 live sites (including S01/S02) are untouched.

note: Item 7 Batch 26 formally accepts S01 (src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply.ts:164, resolveEmployeeBuiltinStewardWorkspaceDir) and S02 (get-reply.ts:165, resolveAgentWorkspaceDir) as personal_local first-materialization residuals that are NOT counted toward the Item 7 production retirement target, per operator decision A2. Justification rests on two independent walls: (1) the accepted Batch 25 S01/S02 Semantic Gate (#725) established they are not honestly retirable by a resolver swap (no personal principal at the call site; agentId-only canonical query forbidden); (2) an implementation attempt of the personal provisioning path was empirically shown to violate the Phase 0 freeze (buildUserOwnedWorkspaceCatalogEntry is a watched SYNTHESIS_SYMBOL; minting a Catalog binding in the production read path is added production Catalog synthesis, which the freeze forbids) and personal_local has no pre-existing binding to read; the attempt was reverted with no residue. S01/S02 are unreachable in managed_enterprise (resolveWorkspaceDirAfterAuthorization fail-closes managed to null and only runs personalFallback in personal_local), so they carry no managed/multi-tenant isolation risk. This change retires nothing, modifies no source, does not touch the retirement scan (remaining/liveWriteWatchIndex stay 10, frozenWriteWatchIndex stays 38), keeps item 7 not-met, and preserves every lock (deployAuthorized=false, live=forbidden, phase1bExecutionBlocked=true, productionCatalogWrite=none, schemaV2ProductionWrite=false). It reframes the Item 7 closeout target to the 8 managed/production memory index/sync sites; the honest full-zero path (A1: persistent personal Catalog + onboarding provisioning + migration) remains available as a separate future project. It requests ONLY an S01/S02 Personal-Local Residual Acceptance Review and does NOT request retirement, baseline change, Stage C production wiring, Item 7 met, Phase 1B unlock, or LIVE.
